desc: Derive the contribution formula for a fixed value \(x\) when it appears before a sequence whose total digit length is known.
Derive and prove the random-priority integral reduction for all permutation contributions.
Compute the global grouped polynomial and one exclusion polynomial per digit-length class in \(O(N\cdot \#\text{lengths})\).
Precompute digit lengths, class counts/sums, factorials, modular inverses, and integration inverses modulo 998244353.
Implement the resulting algorithm in Python with stdin/stdout handling and modular arithmetic.
Validate combinatorial factors and sample cases.
